method: Sequential runs, identical precomputed official mel features; includes frontend, encoder and greedy decoder, excludes JavaScript mel extraction, cache loading, capture and display. First run is cold; two subsequent runs form the warm median. Unchanged ONNX weights and session options.
limitations: One clip; not a corpus latency or accuracy benchmark.
No physical-phone latency, memory or battery measurement.
Embedded hosts without cross-origin isolation/shared memory remain single-threaded.
